notes: Chunk 125: six pages, one Common Crawl snapshot each (CC-MAIN-2023-40), no live copies in the chunk. All six snapshots readable. management-business-uconn-edu (UConn Management alumni, 2023-09-30): 50 rows. Format is "Name, 'YY Ph.D., Institution" followed by the dissertation title; YY taken as graduation year. The institution has no title or date and the page header says graduates "have gone on to" faculty positions, so it may be a current rather than first affiliation (e.g. Franz Willi Kellermanns at UNC Charlotte, Zeki Simsek at Clemson, Semin Park at Iowa). Sharon Foley '98 has no institution. "Avinash Mainkar , '00 Ph.D. George Mason University" lacks the comma on the page. opim-business-uconn-edu (UConn OPIM alumni, 2023-10-03): 38 rows, same format. Three non-academic affiliations (1010 Data, Dow Chemical, Technology Solutions Experts). Spellings copied as printed, including "Bloomsberg University of Pennsylvania" and "Jamestown Madison University" (likely Bloomsburg / James Madison) and "Kaveepan Lertwacuara". The OPIM department covers operations, information systems and analytics; the page does not separate fields. mitsloan-mit-edu recent academic placements (2023-09-22): 52 rows across nine area headings; "PhD 2022" taken as graduation year; academic-only list ("where these recent graduates are today"), so these are current academic affiliations at snapshot time, not necessarily first jobs. Allison Cole is marked "after NBER postdoc". No Operations Management/Operations Research area appears on this snapshot. Area headings normalised from all-caps to title case in the program field. bauer-uh-edu management placements (2023-10-01): 28 rows under "Our Ph.D. alumni accepted academic positions at:"; the parenthetical year is unlabelled, so yearMeaning is "unstated". This is the Management & Leadership program, not Supply Chain/Decision Sciences. business-wisc-edu job candidates (2023-09-30): one candidate (Yerim Sim, Management and Human Resources, "PhD Student"); no year on the page; her email address was omitted. All other areas show "No items found." business-wisc-edu placements (2023-10-03): 74 rows under "Selected PhD Placements" / "Representative placements by discipline in tenure-track positions"; years taken as placement years (headings are bare years). Only four Operations and Information Management rows (2016-2022). Real Estate section lists no names (non-academic positions not reported).
